in_sanskrit.name: Monoj
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है One's only
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Monoj एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'mono' meaning 'one' and 'j' meaning 'alone' or 'only'. This name signifies being the only one in existence or being someone's sole possession.

in_tamil.name: Monoj
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் One's only
in_tamil.long_meaning: Monoj ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'mono' meaning 'one' and 'j' meaning 'alone' or 'only'. This name signifies being the only one in existence or being someone's sole possession.

in_telugu.long_meaning: Monoj ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'mono' meaning 'one' and 'j' meaning 'alone' or 'only'. This name signifies being the only one in existence or being someone's sole possession.

in_marathi.name: Monoj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Monoj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'mono' meaning 'one' and 'j' meaning 'alone' or 'only'. This name signifies being the only one in existence or being someone's sole possession.

in_bengali.name: Monoj
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ One's only
